description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to understand the proprietary 9-point scoring system. (2) Correctly implement the memorial scoring: sort each team's 3 scores [low, mid, high] and compare pairwise (low vs low, mid vs mid, high vs high) — each comparison awards 1 point to the winner (3 pts max). (3) Correctly implement oral argument scoring: for each of 3 judges, sum both players' scores for each team, compare the two sums — the team with the higher judge-sum gets 2 points; do this for all 3 judges (6 pts max). The critical proprietary trap: a naive agent might simply compare total oral scores rather than using the per-judge 2-point comparison mechanism. (4) Apply the win condition: a team wins the match if their total big points (memorial + oral) >= 5 out of 9. (5) Rank teams by wins first, then by accumulated big points as the tiebreaker — NOT by raw score totals. (6) Generate the knockout bracket using the exact 1-vs-16, 2-vs-15, 3-vs-14... pairing rule based on overall rankings. The output must be structured JSON with team_stats, group_standings, overall_ranking, match_results, and knockout_bracket fields.
